records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, River Partners!
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *River Partners* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero product activity (no project, no invite, no milestone) and no reply to three Wrenfield emails [email:1577d17e][email:b58d64bf][email:d4dc30fe], no tickets filed. Silent, fully unengaged accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though the active Pro subscription leaves some chance.

draft.subject: A hand getting River Partners' first project up
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

I know a new tool can slip down the list in a busy week, so no pressure at all. When you're ready, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and projects are the main organizing unit with tasks living inside them. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's useful, I can walk you through setting up that first project on a short call this week -- just tell me a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
